primary_kpis.decisionable_when: the schema-4 private ledger learning contract is current, reconciled and valid

primary_kpis.definition: Count of unique affiliate sale ids whose latest lifecycle state is paid in the last 28 calendar dates.
primary_kpis.decisionable_when: the schema-4 private ledger learning contract is current, reconciled and paid_transactions is valid

GSC 28-day snapshot metadata and hashes match

guardrails: affiliate disclosure and attribution must pass
content-scoped official sources fail closed per placement
no provider watermark in active publish media
publication and deploy remain separately owner-gated

decision_rules.when: any safety or integrity guard fails
decision_rules.action: repair the guard failure before growth work

decision_rules.when: analytics is stale, unversioned, hash-mismatched, or untrusted
decision_rules.action: repair measurement; raw values may be displayed but no winner, timing, cadence, or scale action is allowed

decision_rules.when: paid affiliate revenue and paid transaction count are both zero while trusted intent exists
decision_rules.action: audit offer fit, landing continuity, merchant outcome capture, and commission logging before adding reach

decision_rules.when: paid affiliate revenue is positive and at least one paid transaction exists
decision_rules.action: run one bounded experiment on the revenue-producing funnel and protect all guardrails

baseline_target.target: At least one paid affiliate transaction with positive paid affiliate revenue in one complete trusted 28-day window with zero guardrail violations.
baseline_target.next_target_rule: Set a numeric growth target only after two complete trusted windows establish a baseline.

criteria.acceptance: Observation is from the current cadence window and the decision-readiness evidence hash and raw facts agree.
Every declared executable guardrail returned an explicit same-run pass with exit code 0.
The private 28-day affiliate ledger is readable, reconciled, and contract-valid.
GA4 trust and bundle plus the GSC bundle are current, hash-bound, and decisionable.
The current calendar proves exact content_id source mapping and fail-closed source evaluation; unrelated global monitor queues remain diagnostic only.
Publication authority, a publishable calendar item, and local/live release parity all pass.
At least one unique paid affiliate transaction and positive paid affiliate revenue exist in the current window; pending and approved outcomes do not count.

feedback_cadence.daily_acceptance: A same-run scorecard, blocker-first action queue, validation result, error-learning snapshot, control-health KPI set, and owner requests are written to the private run directory.
feedback_cadence.weekly_acceptance: A comparable weekly scorecard records criterion transitions, recurring/resolved/regressed error fingerprints and a delta, or explicitly resets the baseline when policy/evidence is not comparable.
progression_rules: daily scores are provisional and cannot ratify maturity progression
weekly comparison requires a valid prior weekly scorecard under the same canonical policy hash
a score increase requires at least one failed-to-passed criterion transition
a reopened hard blocker is regression even when the uncapped raw score is higher
missing, stale, malformed, or hash-mismatched evidence scores zero for that criterion
growth work cannot appear before or beside an unresolved hard blocker

task_receipt_monitoring.legacy_schema_policy: Only exact hash-bound schema-2 receipts in the migration attestation are diagnostic-only. Known prior invalid evidence remains LEGACY_INVALID; all unknown, mutated, future, boolean, or newer schema values fail closed and never enter trusted KPIs.
task_receipt_monitoring.scheduler_sla_source: Windows Task Scheduler and parent-process correlation are required separately. A receipt proves only an exact hash-bound command sequence observed through an unverified invocation; it does not prove which parent launched the runner.

control_health_kpis.definition: Share of accountable hash-valid daily and weekly command sequences observed through unverified invocations in the last 7 days that wrote a terminal receipt. COMPLETED_WITH_BLOCKERS and ABORTED count as terminal continuity; RUNNING receipts below the bounded task timeout are reported as active but excluded from the rate, while stuck RUNNING receipts enter the denominator as failures. RUNNER_FAILED and UNVERIFIED_NONZERO remain separate failure diagnostics. The official rate is unavailable until receipt instrumentation has covered the full window; the exact currently executing receipt is excluded until its runner closes it. Receipts do not prove a parent process or Windows-scheduled launch.
control_health_kpis.decision: Below target, repair runner/evidence continuity before content or growth work.

control_health_kpis.definition: Count of currently observed error fingerprints seen in at least two complete control runs.
control_health_kpis.decision: Recurring incidents receive priority over equally ranked new incidents.

control_health_kpis.definition: Count of previously resolved error fingerprints that reappear in the current complete control run.
control_health_kpis.decision: Any regression blocks maturity progression until the cause and missing regression test are recorded.

control_health_kpis.definition: Count within the same 7-day control window of hash-valid ABORTED task receipts whose exact terminal step contract proves COMPLETED_BLOCKED. The official value remains unavailable until receipt instrumentation covers the full window; historical FAILED_VALIDATION bundles are unproven diagnostics only.
control_health_kpis.decision: A publication block must keep publication closed without terminating independent diagnostics.

control_health_kpis.definition: Hours between the latest complete control bundle and the current evaluation time.
control_health_kpis.decision: Stale evidence is unavailable for decisions and triggers evidence-continuity repair.

error_learning.resolution_rule: An open fingerprint is resolved only when it is absent from the next complete control run; an incomplete or failed control run cannot prove resolution.
error_learning.priority_rule: Within the same policy rank, prioritize regressed and consecutively recurring action kinds before new incidents.
error_learning.repair_boundary: Only deterministic local repairs or scoped authorized agent changes may be applied; every repair requires a new validation run and external mutations remain owner-gated.

acceptance_criteria: Every named guard returns exit code 0 in one new same-run observation.
GA4 trust and its exact 28-day bundle are decisionable in a new observation.
No winner, timing, cadence, or scale conclusion is produced from blocked evidence.
GSC query and page files match one current hash-bound 28-day metadata bundle.
A new official-source snapshot passes freshness and integrity validation.
The private affiliate ledger passes its full contract with unique transaction ids and reconciled metadata.
The audit links one trusted intent path to landing continuity, merchant outcome capture, and commission logging evidence.
No reach expansion is selected from clicks alone.
The weekly scorecard is eligible, contains no hard blocker, and meets the minimum score.
The experiment changes one bounded variable and declares metric, guardrail, stop condition, and review date.
The owner confirms the private egress identity outside the scheduled task.
A later capture records the resulting GA4 trust state without exposing the private value.
The owner reviews the exact pending claim packets and records an explicit acknowledgement decision.
A new source snapshot reports zero pending reviews and zero errors.
